name: Juho Station
genre: Global crate-digging and genre-fluid deep cuts
description: A 13,000-track archive built for pure discovery—if you want to find new music, you are guaranteed to find it here. The rotation spans underground house, experimental electronic, classical, and hip-hop, heavily featuring rare global cuts (like 70s Indonesian, 60s Brazilian, and Ethio-jazz) that you simply won't find on major streaming platforms.
